subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft and pricing escalation for NimbleRetail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft and pricing escalation for NimbleRetail

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning — appreciated the clarity on your A/B test goals for the Q3 storefront rollout and the need for predictable latency under 150ms for the personalization API. As discussed, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can align internal approvals with your procurement timelines.

Quick summary / asks: 
- Target close: 2026-04-16 (aligns with your procurement window)
- Key milestones in the attached MAP: PO issuance, SOC2 evidence review, on-prem sandbox access, pilot completion, and go-live readiness test.
- Pricing ask: Nimble asked for a 30% discount at a 12-month committed level. I’ve flagged this to our pricing/exec team for review — cc’d Aditya and Dev for visibility.

Next concrete steps:
1) Please confirm the owners and dates in the attached MAP (column "Sophie Confirm"), especially procurement milestone and target PO date.
2) I’ll escalate the 30% discount request to our pricing committee today and follow up by EOD Tue with decision or counter.
3) We will provide SOC2 summary and a short sandbox access plan (see attachments).

Attachments: [Attachment: NimbleRetail_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)], [Attachment: Price_Scenarios.pdf (pdf, 110KB)]

If helpful, I can set a 20-minute sync with procurement + product to run through the MAP on Tue.

Thanks,

--

Hi Marissa — a couple procurement items to confirm: 

1) We need visibility into the committed throughput and a simple runbook for sandbox access (who will manage keys, expected data snapshots).
2) Pricing: the 30% discount is aggressive for our budget; we still need to see the list price and the discount band tied to committed QPS or token volume. Please include a "commit vs. discount" table.
3) Compliance: procurement will request SOC2 Type II report prior to final signature, plus an IP/data segregation clause for the sandbox.

Can you get a revised MAP with a pricing scenarios sheet by Fri 2026-03-19? That will let procurement present to finance for the 2026-03-29 decision.

Regards,

Procurement Manager | NimbleRetail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@nimble-retail.com>, Mark Johnson <m.johnson@nimble-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing escalation: NimbleRetail (DEAL-9842) — request for discount approval and commit guidance

Team —

Following the discovery and procurement thread, Nimble (Sophie + Mark) have requested a 30% discount aligned to a 12-month commit; procurement needs pricing scenarios (commit vs discount) by Fri 2026-03-19 and a final decision for finance review by 2026-03-29.

Key asks for exec/pricing review:
- Approve or propose counter to the 30% discount request. If approved, do we require a minimum committed QPS or token spend threshold?
- If discount is constrained, propose a credit (one-time onboarding credit) + smaller percentage discount tied to a 24-month commit.
- Confirm whether we can provide a sandbox data segregation clause and timeline to deliver SOC2 Type II report summary.

Attached are the MAP v1 and three price scenarios. My recommended approach (based on initial forecast from product):
A) 20% discount for 12-month commit at $X/month baseline (fast approval route)
B) 30% discount for 12-month commit + minimum monthly QPS/tokens threshold (requires legal to sign off)
C) 15% discount + $50k onboarding credit for a 24-month commit (preferred for revenue visibility)

Timelines: pricing decision requested by Tue EOD 2026-03-17 so we can prepare the revised MAP and price scenarios by Fri 2026-03-19.

Can you weigh in? Sophie/Mark are on a tight procurement cadence so a timely answer is critical.

Thanks,
--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@nimble-retail.com>, Mark Johnson <m.johnson@nimble-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing escalation: NimbleRetail (DEAL-9842) — request for discount approval and commit guidance

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the MAP and scenarios. Summary decision and conditions below: 

Decision: Approve a conditional 25% discount with the following binding conditions (exec-approved):
1) Minimum 12-month term with a committed monthly token spend of >= 1.2M tokens (we will provide the monitoring/reporting hook in the Console).
2) If Nimble fails to meet the monthly minimum for two consecutive months in the first six months, the discount will step down to 15% until the committed threshold is met.
3) Offer a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 (applied on first invoice) instead of a larger multi-year credit.
4) Legal must sign the sandbox data segregation clause; Security must confirm delivery timeline for SOC2 Type II summary. Dev/ Hannah, please confirm feasibility and an estimated delivery date for the SOC2 summary and sandbox runbook by EOD Thu (2026-03-19).

Next steps from Sales (Marissa):
- Publish revised MAP reflecting the conditional 25% discount, commit thresholds, and the $25k onboarding credit by Fri 2026-03-19.
- Include a clear "commit vs. discount" table and the DocuSign route for the 12-month SOW.
- Offer a 20-minute pricing walkthrough with Nimble on Thu 2026-03-18 if needed.

Marissa — I think this is a fair trade-off to protect unit economics while being responsive to Nimble's timeline. If procurement pushes harder on 30% we can escalate, but this is the exec position to move the deal to contract.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | (650) 555-0166

[Attachment: Approval_Note_25pct.pdf (pdf, 18KB)]
